title: Receipts
subtitle: Payments received, refunds and bounced cheques

list.label: Receipts, refunds and reversals
list.shown: Showing the latest {shown} of {total}. Search to find older ones.

receive.title: Receive payment
receive.subtitle: Money received from a customer in the office
receive.chequeNote: A cheque counts as paid on the day it is received. If it bounces, reverse the receipt.

modeHint.auto: The amount settles the oldest unpaid invoices first; only the excess becomes an advance.
modeHint.manual: Type the amount for each invoice you choose. What is left settles the other open invoices, oldest first; only the excess becomes an advance.
modeHint.advance: The whole amount is an advance, for example a payment on a quotation before the work.

receive.nothingOwed: The customer owes nothing: the whole amount becomes an advance.
receive.advanceExplain: The advance gets its own payment tax invoice (INV-) with VAT included. The final invoice deducts it later.
receive.openWarning: The customer has open invoices that this payment will not settle:
receive.advanceReason: Reason for keeping it as an advance
receive.advanceNotAllowed: Keeping the amount as an advance while the customer has open invoices needs a special permission. Choose "Oldest first".

effects.title: When saved:
effects.advance: Issues an advance payment invoice of AED {amount} (VAT AED {vat})

confirm.title: Issue an advance payment invoice
confirm.body: A tax invoice for the advance payment (INV-) will be issued for AED {amount}, VAT AED {vat}. Are you sure?
confirm.yes: Yes, receive and issue the invoice

problems.invalid: Enter an amount such as 150 or 150.50.
problems.zero: The amount must be more than zero.
problems.over: The amounts chosen add up to more than the payment.
problems.shares: Correct the amounts marked in red.
problems.nothingChosen: Type an amount for at least one invoice, or choose "Oldest first".

detail.advanceInvoice: Payment invoice issued for the advance:
detail.reverses: This reversal undoes an earlier payment.

reverse.title: Reverse the payment
reverse.explain: A reversal (RVS-) undoes this payment. The invoices it paid become unpaid again. A payment invoice it created is cancelled with a credit note. This cannot be undone.
reverse.noteMissing: Write a note for this reason.
reverse.deducted: This payment cannot be reversed: a final invoice has already deducted the payment invoice it created. Ask the accountant.

openingBalance.title: Customer opening balance
openingBalance.explain: What this customer owed, or was owed, on the go-live day. It can be entered only once.
openingBalance.onceOnly: The opening balance is already entered and cannot be changed. Later corrections are made with credit or debit notes.
openingBalance.duplicate: This customer already has an opening balance.

statement.title: Statement of account
statement.badDates: The start date must be on or before the end date.
statement.sign: A positive balance is what the customer owes; a negative balance is what we owe them.

account.title: Account
account.unavailable: The balance could not be loaded.
